digest.component_or_area: review gates discovery and policy enforcement
propositions: Plan review and code review currently make discovery decisions through partially independent registry, routing, runner, checkpoint, and failure paths, allowing inconsistent policy application across gates

A unified review-discovery architecture must derive effective-policy from an immutable repository-bound snapshot including built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, routing, prompts, and applicability, with gate-owned strategies and a shared executor
Project code-review LLM criteria must require non-empty repository-relative globs; project.review-phase-boundaries must migrate from empty list to ["**"] without changing membership

The new discovery executor must emit typed outcomes (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled) with only success/resumed able to seed the new checkpoint namespace, while preserving gate-specific scheduler, topology, and response contracts
rebar review-plan --retry must reuse eligible successes, retry only missing calls with fresh budget, refuse stale lineages before model calls, and be documented across all canonical operator surfaces
The workflow editor must separate editable Authored Workflow from read-only Effective Policy and reject empty project code-review LLM glob lists with ["**"] remediation guidance
